title: Deleted-feed media items remain fetchable by direct item ID
reasoning: The item-detail route fetches a MediaItem solely by primary key and returns its full content without checking whether the parent feed has been soft-deleted. Other feed-scoped flows treat deleted feeds as absent, and deletion only marks the feed as deleted without deleting or hiding its existing media_items. A client that has or guesses an item UUID can still retrieve full transcript/content after the feed is deleted, which conflicts with the soft-delete visibility model used elsewhere in this file.
reproduction: Create a feed and media item, delete the feed via the matching delete endpoint, then call GET /api/media/items/{item_id}. The route still returns 200 with MediaItemRead because it only calls session.get(MediaItem, item_id).
recommendation: Have get_media_item join or load the parent MediaFeed and return 404 when the feed is missing, soft-deleted, or otherwise not visible. Keep the behavior consistent with _ensure_feed_exists.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for GET /items/{item_id}, and the repository search only showed tests for retry endpoints under /api/media/items.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that creates a media feed and item, soft-deletes the feed, then asserts GET /api/media/items/{item_id} returns 404 instead of the full item.
minimumFixScope: Update get_media_item to validate parent feed visibility before formatting and returning the item.
